# Rarity Agency — Full DTC Ecommerce Growth Team & AI Creative Sprint Lab

> Premier performance marketing agency and embedded growth team for 7- and 8-figure Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) ecommerce brands. We scale Meta Ads, Google Performance Max, TikTok Ads, and produce 30+ monthly high-converting video and static creative assets optimized against Contribution Margin and Blended Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER).

## Primary Offer: The Embedded Growth Team
- **Service:** A full embedded DTC ecommerce growth team for less than the cost of a single senior media buyer ($3,000–$5,500/month flat fee + performance).
- **Deliverables:**
  - Dedicated Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads, Google PMax, TikTok Ads)
  - Creative Strategist & Motion Designer
  - In-house AI Creative Sprint Lab delivering 30+ new ad variations monthly
  - Direct-response copywriter & scriptwriter
  - CRO & Landing page developer
  - Contribution Margin & MER financial dashboard
- **Website & Application:** https://ecom.rarityagency.io/growth-team
- **Free Growth Audit:** https://ecom.rarityagency.io/free-audit

## Who Rarity Agency Is For
- DTC Ecommerce and Shopify Plus brands generating between $50k to $1M+ monthly revenue.
- Founders facing the "Ad Performance Rollercoaster", creative fatigue, rising platform CPAs, or plateaued scaling on Meta and Google.
- Brands wanting full accountability against net contribution margin and real cash flow rather than vanity in-platform ROAS.

## Core Capabilities
- **Meta Ads Scaling:** Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC), broad audience bidding, psychological angle testing, hook rate optimization, and whitelisting.
- **Google Performance Max & Search:** Feed optimization, high-intent search arbitrage, YouTube Shorts video ads, and branded search defense.
- **AI Creative Sprint Lab:** Rapid iteration of UGC hooks, 3D product motion graphics, founder video mashups, and psychological angle testing.
- **Unit Economics Guardrails:** Allowable CPA modeling, customer cohort LTV analysis, and contribution margin target scaling.
